summary.intent: Create a complete, well-architected Web endpoint for Suhui, not merely a faster enhancement of the existing desktop-hosted remote reader.
confirmed: Current project is desktop-only; apps/ssr has been removed.
Existing remote browser entry is lightweight and incomplete.
User does not prioritize speed over architectural completeness.
User agrees with expanding Application Services and introducing runtime service adapters.

Target is not an independently deployed apps/server product. The desired architecture is to expand apps/desktop/layer/main/src/application/* so HTTP and IPC both call the same Electron-main-hosted application services.

First complete Web version must include reading, subscription create/update/delete, batch subscription management, refresh, unread/read state, settings pages, import/export, RSSHub configuration, and PDF export.
First version keeps the current no-auth remote access model: any browser that can reach the IP:port has full Web permissions.

User explicitly confirmed the no-auth risk after pressure: anyone on the reachable LAN/VPN endpoint may perform high-permission actions including settings changes, import/export, batch subscription changes, refreshes, PDF export, and read/unread mutations.

Decision boundaries are confirmed: the agent may decide service splits, IPC/HTTP adapter interfaces, Web runtime adapter module boundaries, remote UI migration/replacement strategy, test layering, and migration order. The agent must ask before changing the no-auth model, adding first-version scope, introducing new top-level app/package, changing local Postgres as the single source of truth, deleting the old remote entry, or large-scale removing existing modules.

build_blockers: Known residual project setup issue: pnpm --filter @suhui/electron-main build still fails on existing rootDir/include issues around desktop config/plugin files plus pre-existing test type errors.
